title: Settings
subtitle: Configure and manage your YA-WAMF instance
language_desc: Changes UI text and notification content.

date_format.label: Date format
date_format.desc: Pick a default display format for dates.

time_format.label: Time format
time_format.desc: Choose a 12 hour or 24 hour clock.

video_circuit.title: Video Analysis Paused
video_circuit.message: Auto video analysis paused after {failures} failures.

data.title: Data Management
data.maintenance_max_concurrent_help: Best practice is 1. Increase this only if you intentionally want backfill, taxonomy repair, timezone repair, or analyze-unknowns to overlap.
data.purge_confirm: Permanently delete {count, plural, one {# detection} other {# detections}} and the BirdNET-Go audio older than {days} days? Favourites and each species' newest kept visits stay. This cannot be undone.
data.auto_cleanup_note: Automatic cleanup runs at startup, then every 24 hours
data.cache_clips: Keep copies of Frigate's event clips
data.cache_high_quality_event_snapshot_jpeg_q: Higher values keep more detail but create larger derived snapshot files.
data.cache_garden_share: Includes {size} kept for confirmed Garden animals
data.cache_cleanup_confirm: Delete cached photos and clips older than the retention period, and cached files that no longer belong to a detection? Favourites and each species' newest kept visits stay. This cannot be undone.
data.config_backup_desc: Export or restore the complete YA-WAMF configuration as JSON, including secrets.
data.config_backup_secret_warning: Backup files include tokens, webhooks, passwords, and auth secrets. Treat them like credentials.
data.config_backup_restore_note: After importing on a fresh install, run a detection backfill to rebuild the event history from Frigate.
data.config_backup_export_confirm: This backup includes secrets such as tokens, webhooks, passwords, and auth secrets. Store it somewhere private?
data.config_backup_import_confirm: Importing this backup replaces the current YA-WAMF configuration, including secrets. This installation keeps its own sign-in sessions and the key for its stored OAuth tokens. Continue?
data.config_backup_imported: Configuration backup imported ({count, plural, one {# section changed} other {# sections changed}}). Run a backfill when you are ready.
data.config_backup_invalid_json: The selected file is not valid JSON.
data.diagnostics_desc: Open the Health tab for backend status, grouped incidents, and support bundles.
data.timezone_repair_desc: Validate older detection timestamps against Frigate and repair only safe whole-hour timezone offsets.
data.timezone_repair_note: This only updates detections when Frigate still has the matching event and the timestamp difference looks like a real timezone offset.
data.timezone_repair_preview_found: {count, plural, one {# detection can be repaired.} other {# detections can be repaired.}}
data.timezone_repair_preview_none: No safe timezone repairs were found.
data.timezone_repair_confirm: Apply safe timezone repairs to the previewed detections?
data.timezone_repair_apply_success: Repaired {count, plural, one {# detection} other {# detections}}.
data.backfill_desc: Query Frigate history to fetch and classify past events.
data.backfill_validation_select_both: Select both start and end dates.
data.backfill_validation_order: Start date must be before or equal to end date.
data.batch_analysis_long_desc: Run video analysis on all detections labeled as "Unknown Bird". This will queue background tasks to download clips and re-classify them.
data.batch_analysis_circuit_open: Circuit Breaker Open (Paused due to failures)
data.cleanup_success: Cleanup complete. Deleted {count, plural, one {# old detection} other {# old detections}}.
data.cache_cleanup_success: Cache cleanup complete! Deleted {snapshots} snapshots, {clips} clips ({freed} freed).
data.cache_high_quality_event_snapshots_help: After an event ends, choose the clearest main-stream frame and best crop available. The full frame is kept when a reliable crop cannot be made.
data.cache_crop_detector_ready_help: Frigate tracking hints and the crop detectors are evaluated automatically.
data.cache_crop_fallback_ready_help: Frigate tracking hints are used automatically; detector crops join in when a model is installed.
data.frigate_missing_behavior: When Frigate no longer has the event/media
data.frigate_missing_behavior_mark: Mark missing and keep local data
data.frigate_missing_behavior_note: This policy is applied during manual scans and scheduled checks. Use mark-missing when YA-WAMF should keep detections longer than Frigate.
data.purge_missing_media_confirm: Scan detections whose Frigate event, clip, or snapshot is missing and apply the configured policy?
data.purge_missing_clips: Scan detections missing clips in Frigate
data.purge_missing_snapshots: Scan detections missing snapshots in Frigate
data.media_integrity_note: Re-checks a batch of detections against Frigate every few hours and applies the upstream-missing behaviour above. It never changes anything while Frigate is unreachable, and a long history takes several runs to work through.
data.purge_missing_clips_confirm: Scan detections whose clips are missing in Frigate and apply the configured policy?
data.purge_missing_snapshots_confirm: Scan detections whose snapshots are missing in Frigate and apply the configured policy?
data.purge_missing_scan_success: Scan complete: checked {checked}, missing {missing}, deleted {deleted}, marked missing {marked}, kept {kept}, restored {restored}. Unable to check {errors}; their saved state was preserved.
data.clear_favorites_desc: Removes every favourite marker and its archived photo and clip. Detections and cached media stay.
data.clear_favorites_confirm: Remove all favourite markers and their archived photos and clips? The visits stay in history. This cannot be undone.
data.clear_favorites_success: Removed {count, plural, one {# favorite marker} other {# favorite markers}}.
data.archive_failed_count: {count} could not be archived. Open the visit to try again.
data.per_species_minimum: Keep photos of the newest visits per species
data.per_species_minimum_help: This many of each species' newest visits keep their photos after they pass the history window, so a rare bird keeps its pictures. Video is not kept longer. 0 turns this off.
data.per_species_maximum: Most visits per species with photos and video
data.per_species_maximum_help: A species' visits beyond this number lose their photos and video, oldest first. The visits stay in history. Favourites don't count. 0 means no limit.
data.max_size_mb_help: When photos and video use more than this, the oldest are removed first. Favourites and their archive are kept. This limit and the one above win over the photo floor. 0 means no limit.
data.bird_scan_mode_help: Applies to manual and automatic scans. Standard uses less CPU. Intensive also searches tiles in large frames and classifies more crop choices. Neither guarantees every bird is found.
data.cache_clips_help: Frigate already keeps these. Copies survive Frigate deleting them, at about the size of the clip each.
data.cache_always_kept: Photos, full-visit clips and previews are always kept. The limits below decide for how long and how much space they use.
data.cache_unavailable: The media folder can't be written, so photos and video are not being kept. Check the folder's permissions; system checks show the error.
data.cache_high_quality_storage_note: Each visit then also keeps full-resolution frames, often several MB, so set a storage limit if space is tight.
data.automatic_multi_bird_scan_help: Off by default to reduce processing. Normal bird identification and the target bird’s crop continue, and existing findings are kept. Use Find more birds on a photograph whenever you need a scan. When enabled, scans run on retained whole frames.
data.purge_disabled_forever: Nothing to purge: history is kept forever.
data.purge_disabled_none: No detections are older than {days} days.
data.retention_shrink_counting: Counting the detections older than {days} days…
data.retention_shrink_note: Saving this permanently deletes {count, plural, one {# detection} other {# detections}} older than {days} days at the next cleanup (on restart, then every 24 hours).
data.retention_shrink_uncounted: Saving this permanently deletes every detection older than {days} days at the next cleanup (on restart, then every 24 hours).
data.retention_shrink_manual: Automatic cleanup is off, so saving deletes nothing by itself. Purge Old Records would then delete {count, plural, one {# detection} other {# detections}} older than {days} days.
data.retention_shrink_manual_uncounted: Automatic cleanup is off, so saving deletes nothing by itself. Purge Old Records would then delete every detection older than {days} days.
data.retention_shrink_kept_floor: Favourites and the newest {floor, plural, one {# detection} other {# detections}} of each species are kept. Older BirdNET-Go audio and Garden animal records are deleted too.
data.retention_shrink_kept: Favourites are kept. Older BirdNET-Go audio and Garden animal records are deleted too.
data.retention_confirm_button: Save and delete {count, plural, one {# detection} other {# detections}}

security.title: Security
security.https_warning: Sign-in is on, but this page is served over HTTP, so passwords and sessions can be read on the network. Serve YA-WAMF over HTTPS, for example behind your reverse proxy.

debug.title: Debug Tools
debug.subtitle: Extra switches for testing and diagnostics.
debug.model_eval_desc: Benchmark installed classifiers against taxonomy-verified bird images. Artifacts are stored under /config/yawamf-eval/.
debug.model_eval_action_desc: Run accuracy, latency, and sanity checks against every installed model. Owner-only.
debug.llm_prompts_subtitle: Customize the Markdown structure and tone for AI analysis and conversations.
debug.llm_prompt_style_help: Applies localized defaults for your current language.
debug.strict_non_finite_output_desc: When enabled, all-non-finite classifier outputs are rejected and trigger runtime recovery. Disable only for controlled debugging.

ai.clear_usage_confirm: Are you sure you want to clear AI usage history? This cannot be undone.
ai.provider_info_desc: YA-WAMF uses cloud LLMs for behavioral analysis and natural language interactions. You will need your own API key from the provider.
ai.prompts_subtitle: Customize the behavior of AI features
ai.pricing_help: Override the default token pricing for cost estimation. Format: an array of objects with provider, model, inputPer1M, and outputPer1M.
ai.test_subtitle: Checking the same multi-frame vision format used for detection analysis.
ai.test_configuration_ok: Provider, model, and credential are present.
ai.test_multiframe_ok: {count, plural, one {# JPEG frame was accepted in one request.} other {# JPEG frames were accepted in one request.}}
ai.test_skipped: Not run because an earlier stage failed.
ai.test_probe_note: This sends five representative 1280×720 JPEG frames, matching the count, dimensions, and approximate payload size of a real analysis request.
ai.test_network_error: The diagnostic request could not reach YA-WAMF.

birdnet.title: BirdNET-Go
birdnet.internal_url_help: Backend-only URL used to fetch spectrogram backgrounds, such as the Docker network address.
birdnet.external_url_help: Public HTTPS URL opened by dashboard links. Falls back to the internal URL when empty.
birdnet.audio_buffer_help: How long to keep audio detections for correlation (1-168 hours)
birdnet.match_window_help: Time window for matching audio with visual (±5-3600 seconds)
birdnet.sensor_mapping_empty: No cameras detected. Check Frigate connection.
birdnet.sensor_mapping_help: Map each Frigate camera to BirdNET source names (stable `nm` / display names). For multi-stream cameras, you can enter multiple names separated by commas.
birdnet.source_discovery_error: Failed to load recent BirdNET source names.
birdnet.source_discovery_empty: No BirdNET source names detected yet. Wait for audio detections, then reload Settings.
birdnet.source_discovery_help: Use these detected source names in the mapping fields above. Names are more stable than dynamic IDs across BirdNET-Go restarts.
birdnet.test_subtitle: Confirms BirdNET-Go is reachable, the MQTT broker accepts a publish, and a mock detection flows through the pipeline.

inaturalist.title: iNaturalist
inaturalist.oauth_desc: Connect your iNaturalist account to submit verified detections.
inaturalist.app_owner_note: Requires iNaturalist App Owner approval (account 2+ months old and 10 improving IDs in the last month).
inaturalist.popup_blocked: The sign-in window was blocked. Allow popups for this site and try again.

ebird.title: eBird
ebird.api_key_desc: Required to fetch recent sightings and notable birds.
ebird.export_csv_desc: Download detections in eBird Record Format for manual import.
ebird.export_range_help: Leave both blank to export all detections, or choose an inclusive date range.
ebird.export_range_error: From date must be on or before the To date.
ebird.export_everything_label: Toggle export everything for eBird CSV
ebird.export_everything_help: Turn this on to export all detections and disable the date range.

birdweather.title: BirdWeather
birdweather.token_desc: Available in your station settings under "BirdWeather Token".
birdweather.test_subtitle: Checks that your station token is accepted by BirdWeather.

ha_weather.title: Home Assistant weather
ha_weather.toggle_label: Record the weather from your own sensors instead of the forecast API. A sensor that cannot answer reads as unknown, never as a forecast.
ha_weather.base_url_desc: The address this server can reach, e.g. http://homeassistant.local:8123
ha_weather.token_desc: Created in Home Assistant under your profile, Security, Long-lived access tokens.
ha_weather.entity_desc: The general source, e.g. weather.home. Leave empty to rely on sensor overrides alone.
ha_weather.overrides_desc: A sensor named here outranks the weather entity for its one reading. When it cannot answer, that reading is unknown.
ha_weather.test_subtitle: Fetches the current readings your detections would record.

enrichment.title: Enrichment Sources
enrichment.desc: Sources are selected automatically based on your integrations.
enrichment.fallback_note: Fallbacks apply when a provider cannot supply a field. (eBird falls back to iNaturalist)

auth.title: Authentication
auth.desc: Require a login for full access.
auth.enable_desc: Protect settings and admin actions behind a login
auth.password_placeholder: Leave blank to keep current password
auth.proxy_trust_note: Proxy headers are trusted from all hosts by default. If you run behind a reverse proxy, set trusted proxy hosts to prevent spoofed client IPs.
auth.trusted_proxies_desc: Add your reverse proxy container names or IPs (e.g., nginx-rp, cloudflare-tunnel, 172.19.0.10). Docker DNS names work when services share a network.
auth.trusted_proxies_suggested_note: These are suggestions only. Save will keep the default (trust all) unless you accept or edit them.
auth.trusted_proxies_empty: No trusted proxies configured (all proxies trusted).
auth.avatar_desc: Shown beside your name in the sidebar. It is stored as a small square picture; nothing else from the file is kept.
auth.avatar_too_large: That file is over 8 MB. Choose a smaller picture.
auth.avatar_failed: That file could not be used as a picture. Try a JPEG or PNG.

public_access.title: Public Access
public_access.enable_desc: Guests can view detections without logging in
public_access.show_camera_names_desc: Guests see each camera’s name. Off shows a generic label.
public_access.show_ai_conversation_desc: Allow guests to view AI chat threads on detections
public_access.allow_clip_downloads_desc: Allow guests to download full video clips
public_access.share_base_url_desc: If set, new share links use this public base URL instead of the detected request host.
public_access.show_audio_desc: BirdNET detections, spectrograms and audio clips. Off means visitors see no audio surfaces at all.
public_access.show_snapshots_desc: Snapshots and thumbnails. Off means visitors see placeholders instead of images.
public_access.show_clips_desc: Video clips and their previews. Off means visitors cannot play video at all; the download switch below only controls saving the file.
public_access.location_precision_desc: Approximate rounds the location to about 10 km before any visitor-facing feature uses it, so sharing your feeder does not publish your address.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Options
accessibility.dyslexia_font_desc: Use OpenDyslexic font for better readability
accessibility.live_announcements_desc: Announce new detections with screen reader alerts.

frigate.title: Frigate NVR
frigate.full_visit_clips_desc: Serve a longer clip window from Frigate recordings around each detection.
frigate.full_visit_supported: {count, plural, one {Continuous coverage is ready for the selected camera.} other {Continuous coverage is ready for all # selected cameras.}}
frigate.full_visit_unavailable: Capability information is unavailable right now.
frigate.full_visit_retention: Guaranteed continuous retention: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
frigate.full_visit_reason_config_unavailable: Frigate config could not be read.
frigate.full_visit_reason_no_matching_cameras: No selected cameras match the current Frigate config.
frigate.full_visit_reason_recordings_disabled: Recording is disabled for the selected cameras. Enable recording and retain at least one continuous day.
frigate.full_visit_reason_continuous_retention_d: Frigate is not retaining a continuous timeline. Set record.continuous.days to at least 1; event-only clips can start late or end early.
frigate.full_visit_reason_record_stream_missing: A selected camera has no recording stream. Add record to its FFmpeg input roles and retain at least one continuous day.
frigate.full_visit_reason_camera_disabled: A selected camera is disabled in Frigate. Enable it before using full-visit clips.
frigate.full_visit_reason_camera_not_found: A selected camera is no longer present in Frigate. Sync the camera list and review your selection.
frigate.full_visit_reason_partial_camera_coverag: Only some selected cameras have continuous recording coverage. Full-visit clips stay unavailable until every selected camera is covered.
frigate.full_visit_reason_camera_configuration_i: The selected cameras have more than one recording configuration issue. Review each camera below.
frigate.full_visit_reason_retention_unknown: Continuous recording retention could not be determined. Validate the Frigate recording config before enabling full visits.
frigate.external_url_desc: The address your browser uses to open Frigate when it differs from the server address above. Used for the 'open in Frigate' link on a detection.
frigate.ingest_labels_desc: Comma-separated. Add the labels your Frigate model uses for birds (e.g. bird, duck, goose); everything listed flows through the bird identification pipeline.
frigate.classification_image_source_desc: The detection snapshot is faster. A recording frame can show more detail when the recording stream is larger than the detect stream and shows the same view. It does not guarantee a better identification.
frigate.classification_image_recording_cost: Frigate decodes one recording frame for each detection, and YA-WAMF downloads and processes it.
frigate.classification_image_recording_fallback: Needs retained recordings and the clean snapshot copy in Frigate ({setting}). Recording frames usually become available 10 to 15 seconds later. After the selected delay, unavailable frames are normally retried for up to 18 seconds before using the detection snapshot. Smaller or differently shaped recording frames also use the snapshot.
frigate.classification_image_recording_scope: Applies to new detections, including past events fetched as missed detections. Saving does not fetch past events or change existing photos; reclassification prefers saved photos.
frigate.test_subtitle: Checks that the Frigate API answers and that the MQTT broker accepts a publish.
frigate.recording_frame_delay_desc: Wait 1 to 120 seconds after the first snapshot moment. Use the latest tracked snapshot metadata received during that wait. Identification and notifications arrive later. This does not wait for every event to end or reclassify saved detections.
frigate.recording_frame_delay_invalid: Enter a recording-frame delay between 1 and 120 seconds.

cameras.title: Cameras to watch
cameras.preview_missing_url: No preview URL available for this camera.
cameras.nest_dedupe_help: Collapses repeat detections of the same species on a nest cam to one per N minutes.
cameras.role_feeder_help: Feeder cam: every Frigate event is treated as a fresh visit (default).
cameras.role_nest_help: Nest box cam: collapses repeat detections of the same species into one per dedupe window so a continuously-present nesting bird does not flood the feed.
cameras.preview_needs_url: Enter the Frigate URL above to preview a camera.
cameras.watch_desc: Choose which Frigate cameras are watched for birds.
cameras.watch_desc_garden: Choose what each Frigate camera is watched for: birds, Garden animals or both.
cameras.every_camera_on: Every Frigate camera is watched for birds, including cameras added to Frigate later.
cameras.every_camera_off: Only the cameras chosen here are watched for birds. A camera added to Frigate later is not watched until you choose it.
cameras.garden_beta_hint: To watch for Garden animals as well, turn on Garden animals in Settings → Beta features.
cameras.list_loading: Reading the camera list from Frigate…
cameras.list_unread: The camera list could not be read from Frigate. Saved cameras are shown; choose Sync Cameras to try again.
cameras.none_found_help: Frigate reported no cameras. Check the Frigate URL above, then choose Sync Cameras.
cameras.not_found_help: Frigate does not list this camera now. Its choices are kept until you change them; choose Off to remove it.
cameras.blocked_last_bird_camera: At least one camera must watch for birds, so birds stay on for this camera.
cameras.blocked_camera_list_unread: Every camera watches for birds. Sync cameras from Frigate before turning birds off for one camera.

telemetry.title: Telemetry
telemetry.desc: Optional, anonymous usage telemetry to help improve YA-WAMF. Disabled by default.
telemetry.privacy_notice: No images, clips, audio, detection content, usernames, emails, or API keys are collected.
telemetry.includes_value: Model type, enabled integrations, notification channels, enrichment mode, access flags
telemetry.geography_value: Approx. country derived from request headers (IP not stored)
telemetry.health_desc: Share deduped backend health issues once per day so recurring failures can be debugged.
telemetry.health_includes_value: Issue fingerprints, component/reason codes, severity, counts, coarse runtime settings, and sanitized context
telemetry.appreciation_tooltip: If you can, please enable telemetry. It helps me understand how YA-WAMF is used and guides improvements.

email.title: Email Notifications
email.desc: Send email alerts for bird detections
email.oauth_desc: Secure authentication using Gmail or Outlook
email.oauth_instructions: Click the button to authorize YA-WAMF to send emails on your behalf. You'll be redirected to {provider} to sign in.
email.only_on_end_desc: Send email notifications only when Frigate publishes the end event (treated as an update).
email.credentials_required: Please configure OAuth or SMTP credentials first
email.oauth_app_credentials_desc: Your Google or Microsoft OAuth app credentials, required before connecting an account.
email.test_needs: Enter the recipient address to send a test.

notifications.audio_only_desc: Only alert when BirdNET audio confirms the detection.
notifications.mode_desc: Pick how and when notifications are sent. Advanced lets you override the exact triggers.
notifications.mode_final_desc: Notify only when the event ends and video analysis (if enabled) is complete.
notifications.mode_standard_desc: Notify when a confirmed detection is created.
notifications.mode_realtime_desc: Notify early and allow update notifications as the detection evolves.
notifications.notify_on_insert_desc: Send notifications only when a new detection is created.
notifications.notify_on_update_desc: Send notifications when detections are updated (higher score or audio confirmed).
notifications.confirmation_policy: Notifications are only sent when a snapshot is confirmed (confidence threshold or audio confirmation) or when video analysis confirms the detection.
notifications.delay_until_video_desc: Wait for auto video analysis before notifying. YA-WAMF automatically uses the video pipeline timing as the minimum wait.
notifications.video_fallback_timeout_desc: Optional extra wait time. YA-WAMF will never wait less than the auto-derived video pipeline minimum.
notifications.cooldown_desc: Minimum time between notifications in minutes (0 to disable).
notifications.enable_notify_hint: Notifications are currently off. Enable "Notify on new detections" or "Notify on updates" to send any alerts.
notifications.species_filter_none_desc: Notify for all species that pass the other filters.
notifications.species_filter_blacklist_desc: Notify for everything except the species below.
notifications.species_filter_whitelist_desc: Notify only for the species below.
notifications.species_filter_blacklist_list: Do not notify for these species
notifications.species_filter_search_placeholder: Search birds by common or scientific name
notifications.notification_language_desc: Language used for the text of notification messages sent to all channels
notifications.instance_url_desc: Public address of this YA-WAMF install. Notifications link back to the detection here; leave blank for no link.
notifications.link_opens_yawamf_desc: The detection on the Detections page, with its clip, snapshots and identification.
notifications.link_opens_frigate_desc: The same tracked object in Frigate's Explore page.
notifications.link_opens_frigate_req: Needs Frigate 0.15 or newer and the Frigate public URL in the Integrations settings.
notifications.link_frigate_url_missing: The Frigate public URL is not set, so notifications carry no link until it is.
notifications.link_preview_others: Discord title, Pushover and email use the same address.

sentence.custom_hint: Custom rules are set under Advanced below.
sentence.species_all_but: {count, plural, one {all but # species} other {all but # species}}
sentence.species_jump: Species filter: {summary}. Jump to the species filter.

notifications.test_failed: The test message could not be sent.
notifications.test_subtitle: Sends one test message using the current settings for this channel.

garden.title: Garden animals
garden.desc: Alerts when a Garden animal is named, separate from bird alerts.
garden.enabled_help: One alert per visit when an animal is named automatically or you accept its species. Apply Settings to save.
garden.use_bird_help: The channels above that are switched on and configured.
garden.choose_help: Uses saved credentials; their bird switches can stay off.
garden.bird_none: No bird channel is switched on and configured, so no Garden alert can be sent. Switch one on above, or choose channels.
garden.choose_one: Choose at least one channel to deliver Garden alerts.
garden.credentials: No saved credentials for {channels}, so Garden alerts there will fail. Add them in the channel cards above.
garden.include_photo_help: Attaches the saved animal crop, or the capture photo when there is no crop. Only confirmed animals are sent, so it is a photo you or the automatic check accepted. Text only if no photo can be read.
garden.privacy: Sends the animal name, camera, sighting time and, if chosen, the photo to these services. The link opens this capture here; a visitor can open it only while public access shares it.
garden.rules: Sent within five minutes of the name being decided, for sightings up to two hours old, so turning alerts on never replays history. One attempt per channel per visit; failed or uncertain sends are not retried.
garden.status: Saved delivery attempts. Accepted by channel: {sent}. Failed: {failed}. Unconfirmed: {unknown}. Skipped: {skipped}.
garden.status_after_apply: Delivery status appears once Apply Settings has switched Garden on.

discord.title: Discord Notifications
discord.test_needs: Enter the webhook URL to send a test.

pushover.title: Pushover Notifications
pushover.device_hint: Comma-separated device names. Leave blank to send to all active devices.
pushover.test_needs: Enter the user key and API token to send a test.

telegram.title: Telegram Notifications
telegram.test_needs: Enter the bot token and chat ID to send a test.

location.title: Location
location.weather_unit_system_desc: Use one consistent unit system for temperature, wind, precipitation, and distances.
location.desc: Used for localized weather context during detections.
location.map_empty: No coordinates configured yet. Set a latitude and longitude (or enable auto-detect) to see the map.
location.map_help: Showing the location currently configured for weather, hotspots, and observations.
location.mode_help: Auto-detect uses your IP/timezone. Manual lets you pin exact coordinates for weather, eBird hotspots, and observation submissions.
location.resolve_empty: No place name available for these coordinates

danger.title: Danger Zone
danger.subtitle: Destructive actions
danger.reset_desc: Resetting the database will permanently delete ALL detections, clear the media cache and remove every archived favourite. This action cannot be undone.
danger.confirm: DANGER: This will delete ALL detections, clear the media cache and remove every archived favourite. This action cannot be undone. Are you sure?
danger.clear_feedback_desc: Clearing personalization feedback will delete all manual tag corrections the AI uses to adjust confidence scores. This will revert the classifier to its baseline accuracy.
danger.clear_feedback_hint: This does not delete detections or media. Re-ranking will begin learning again as you make new manual corrections.
danger.clear_feedback_confirm: Are you sure you want to clear all personalized re-ranking data? This will revert the AI back to its baseline accuracy and cannot be undone.

detection.floor_help: Events below this floor are ignored completely. Events between floor and threshold are saved as "Unknown Bird".
detection.trust_frigate_desc: Skip internal classification if Frigate identified species
detection.write_frigate_sublabel_desc: Append YA-WAMF species labels to Frigate event sublabels
detection.auto_video_desc: Automatically run deep video reclassification for every event
detection.video_retry_note: Retries use exponential backoff to wait for Frigate clip finalization.
detection.cuda_desc: Use NVIDIA GPU for faster ONNX model inference (ConvNeXt, EVA-02)
detection.cuda_not_supported: Your environment does not support CUDA or onnxruntime-gpu is missing.
detection.naming_scientific_sub: Only show scientific names. Hides common names.
detection.blocked_species_picker_desc: Search for a species or other taxon to block it reliably across common-name, scientific-name, and taxonomy-aware matches. Cached detections and legacy raw labels still apply until you remove them.
detection.inference_provider_desc: Only providers included in this image, detected on this host, and supported by the active model are shown.
detection.provider_saved_unavailable: {provider} is saved but is not available in this image, on this host, or for the active model. Choose an available provider or Auto.
detection.execution_mode_desc: Isolated workers, the default, restart safely if a classification stalls or crashes; each worker holds its own copy of the model. In-process shares one copy inside the app: less memory, less isolation.
detection.execution_mode_worker_plan: Resolved for this install: {live} live and {background} background worker processes, each with its own copy of the model.
detection.execution_mode_worker_ram: The active model is estimated at {each} MB per copy, about {total} MB across the workers.
detection.model_lineup_description: Recommended models are ordered first and fit the broadest range of hardware and feeders.
detection.model_lineup_advanced_note: Advanced models are hidden by default because they usually need more RAM, run slower, or cover broader wildlife taxonomies than most installs need.
detection.region_override_desc: Auto uses your configured country. Manual override always wins.
detection.personalized_rerank_desc: Use manual tags to adapt ranking per camera and model. Disable to use base model scores only.
detection.video_concurrency_best_practice_in_proce: In-Process mode shares one backend runtime. Best practice is to keep video concurrency at 1 unless you have verified your model runtime stays stable under overlap.
detection.video_concurrency_best_practice_subproce: Subprocess mode isolates classifier workers more strongly, but raising video concurrency still increases CPU, RAM, and GPU pressure.
detection.cuda_runtime_only: CUDA runtime installed (no NVIDIA GPU detected)
detection.model_manager_subtitle: Recommended models are shown by default. Lower-performing and niche options are hidden until you need them.
detection.model_manager_crop_policy_automatic_desc: YA-WAMF uses the crop policy tested for this model. There is nothing to tune when you switch models.
detection.model_manager_lineup_desc: Recommended models are shown first. Lower-performing and niche options are collapsed below.
detection.model_manager_advanced_hidden: Legacy and lower-performing models are hidden. Use "Show all models" to see every option.
detection.model_manager_host_verification: OpenVINO host verification is shown for the active ONNX model.
detection.model_manager_threshold_hint: Recommended confidence threshold for this model:
detection.model_manager_delete_confirm: Delete {name}? This removes the files from disk. You can download it again later.
detection.model_manager_install_subtitle: Download, validate on your hardware, and enable this model.
detection.model_manager_install_note: Each step runs on your hardware. Nothing becomes active until validation passes.
detection.model_manager_device_set: Fastest verified provider: {provider}{ms}. It will be applied when this model is enabled.
detection.model_manager_validation_needed: Downloaded but not yet validated on your hardware. Validate it to confirm it runs here before you select it.
detection.model_manager_validate_subtitle: Confirm this model runs on your hardware, then enable it for selection.
detection.model_manager_validate_note: Validation trial-loads the model and runs one frame through it, then restores your current model.
detection.model_manager_validate_ran_ok: Ran on {provider}{ms} and produced valid output.
detection.model_manager_provider_cuda_available_ti: CUDA provider is available on this host
detection.model_manager_provider_cuda_unavailable_: CUDA provider is not available on this host
detection.model_manager_provider_openvino_cpu_fall: OpenVINO CPU compile failed and fallback is active
detection.model_manager_provider_openvino_cpu_avai: OpenVINO CPU is available on this host
detection.model_manager_provider_openvino_cpu_unav: OpenVINO CPU is not available on this host
detection.model_manager_provider_openvino_gpu_fall: OpenVINO GPU compile failed and fallback is active
detection.model_manager_provider_openvino_gpu_avai: OpenVINO GPU is available on this host
detection.model_manager_provider_openvino_gpu_unav: OpenVINO GPU is not available on this host
detection.model_manager_provider_fallback_title: Automatic fallback in the order shown
detection.openvino_compile_failure: OpenVINO model incompatibility on this host
detection.openvino_compile_failure_detail: This model cannot compile on the currently selected OpenVINO device. YA-WAMF will keep the model installed but run inference on {fallback}.
detection.crop_priority_desc: Which crop source is tried first. Each option falls back to the next and finally to the full frame, so a bird crop is used whenever one can be produced, even a small one. The selected crop detector tier is respected whenever the model path is used.
detection.crop_tier_desc: Fast keeps the current SSD detector as the default. Accurate uses the experimental YOLOX-Tiny tier and falls back to fast automatically when it is unavailable.
detection.image_flavor_mismatch: The {provider} runtime is not included in the {flavor} image. Use the full image or a matching provider image, then recreate the container. CPU fallback remains available.
detection.compat_unverified: Not yet run on this host. Run the check to verify the providers available in this image.
detection.compat_test_subtitle: Validates every provider available to this image and model against the CPU baseline.
detection.band_own_copy_each: each worker holds its own model copy
detection.model_manager_memory_formula_subprocess: {per} per copy × {live} live + {background} background workers (isolated mode)
detection.model_manager_memory_formula_in_process: {per} for one copy shared inside the app (in-process mode)
detection.worker_counts_desc: Each worker holds its own copy of the model. Leave empty for the default of one. Applied the next time the classifier workers restart.
detection.video_concurrency_follows_workers: Clips are analysed as many at a time as there are background workers. The models classify one image per worker, so a separate concurrency setting could only queue jobs or starve workers.
detection.model_manager_memory_formula_subprocess_: {per} per copy × {live} live + {background} background + {video} video workers (isolated mode)
detection.band_native_recovering: Waiting for isolated workers to resume classification.
detection.band_native_restart: Restart the container to release the stalled runtime.
detection.band_worker_fallback_detail: Isolated workers keep dying during model load; detections continue in the main process.
detection.compat_all_hint: Download and test every registry model, not just installed ones (slower).
detection.compat_result_failed: Some devices failed validation. See the breakdown below.
detection.compat_result_ok: All devices match the CPU baseline.
detection.compat_result_skipped: Some devices could not be validated. See the breakdown below.
detection.compat_result_warn: All devices run, but some differ from the CPU baseline.
detection.compat_results_unavailable: Compatibility results could not be loaded. Please retry.
detection.runtime_refresh_failed: The check finished, but YA-WAMF could not read the runtime it is now using. Reload the page to see the current provider.
detection.compat_stage_run_hint: Compiling and comparing each device against the CPU baseline…
detection.model_manager_repair_needed: This model install is incomplete. Re-download it to restore the missing species names or model configuration before activation.
detection.model_manager_location_desc: This model also uses the feeder coordinates saved in Settings → Integrations → Location. If no valid coordinates are saved, it identifies birds without location. It does not use the date or a location accuracy radius.
detection.bird_finder_standard_desc: Small and quick. Misses many birds that are small in a wide frame.
detection.bird_finder_wide_desc: Reads the whole frame and four overlapping tiles, so it finds far more small and distant birds. A 103 MB download, and each frame takes longer.
detection.bird_finder_fallback: The wide-frame finder is not downloaded yet, so the standard finder is still in use. Download it below to switch.
detection.models_card_desc: Two models work in turn. The bird finder locates each bird in the camera frame; the identification model names its species.
detection.identification_desc: Names the species in each bird image. Larger models need more memory for every worker copy and take longer per image. Coverage differs: some know birds only, others birds and other wildlife.
detection.bird_finder_role: Locates each bird in the camera frame so YA-WAMF can crop and count it. It does not name the species.
detection.bird_finder_device_help: Apply settings to save this device. If it becomes unavailable, the finder uses CPU instead of another accelerator. The fast fallback finder picks its device automatically.
detection.bird_finder_device_checked: Runs on {provider}, passed the device check on this host
detection.bird_finder_device_cpu_only: Runs on the CPU. This host has no graphics or NPU device this finder can use.
detection.bird_finder_device_until_checked: Runs on the CPU until {devices} pass a device check on this host.
detection.bird_finder_device_check_running: Runs on the CPU while YA-WAMF re-checks {devices} on recent bird photos.
detection.bird_finder_device_check_failed: Runs on the CPU. {devices} did not match the CPU on recent bird photos.
detection.bird_finder_device_check_waiting: Runs on the CPU. {devices} will be re-checked after a restart once YA-WAMF has saved bird photos.
detection.bird_finder_check_devices_hint: Compares this finder on each device with the CPU on bird photos, then uses the fastest one that matches. The identification model is not changed.
detection.bird_finder_pending: Apply settings to switch the bird finder. The current finder keeps running until then.
detection.bird_finder_backup: If it cannot find a usable bird, YA-WAMF also tries the fast fallback finder and Frigate's tracking box, and uses the full frame only when none of them gives a reliable crop.
detection.acceptance_desc: How sure the identification model must be before a visit is saved under a species name.
detection.hardware_desc: Which device runs the models, and how much memory they may use. Auto picks the fastest device that passed the check on this host.
detection.compat_panel_desc: Runs the installed models on each device this image can use and compares the results with the CPU. Graphics and NPU devices are used only after they pass here.
detection.frigate_video_desc: Whether to use labels Frigate already has, write YA-WAMF species back to Frigate, and check recorded clips after the snapshot.
detection.bird_finder_recommended_checked: Recommended: {provider}. Passed the device check on this host.
detection.bird_finder_recommended_cpu_only: CPU is the available recommendation. This host offers no compatible accelerator.
detection.bird_finder_recommended_running: Device check running for {devices}. CPU remains available while the check runs.
detection.bird_finder_recommended_failed: {devices} did not match the CPU on recent bird photos. CPU remains available.
detection.bird_finder_recommended_waiting: Waiting for saved bird photos to re-check {devices}. CPU remains available.
detection.bird_finder_recommended_unchecked: CPU until {devices} pass a device check on this host. No accelerator recommendation yet.

llm.title: AI Insights
llm.test_hint: Runs a quick prompt to verify your API key and model.
llm.model_hint: Choose a model that supports image input (vision). Text-only models will fail analysis.
llm.openrouter_model_hint: Enter any OpenRouter model ID (e.g. google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite). Browse models at openrouter.ai/models.

explorer_view.label: Explorer layout
explorer_view.desc: The layout new devices start with. Cards show a snapshot for each visit; a list fits more on screen and lines the times up so you can scan for one. Each device can switch it from the Explorer, and that choice sticks on that device.

system_health.title: System
system_health.description: What this host is doing, and how much of it is this app.
system_health.cores: {count, plural, one {# core} other {# cores}}, no CPU limit on the container
system_health.cores_limited: {count, plural, one {# core} other {# cores}}, limited to {quota}
system_health.share_summary: This app {app} · rest of the host {other} · idle {idle}
system_health.role_other_host_note: Not this app. Cannot be named without the Docker socket.
system_health.note: CPU and memory are read from this container's own processes. Accelerator cells name the runtime a classifier worker actually loaded; NPU utilisation is device-wide and cannot be divided honestly between workers. Anything else on the host is measured only as the CPU remainder.
system_health.unavailable: Load history is not available right now.
system_health.empty: The first samples arrive a few seconds after start.
system_health.cpu_unmeasured: CPU load cannot be measured on this host; the counters it needs are not readable from inside the container.
system_health.no_accelerator: No accelerator counter is readable on this host, so only the CPU is drawn.
system_health.app_scope_note: GPU time is published per process, so that line is the work YA-WAMF sent to the GPU. Another container sharing the same GPU is not visible here.
system_health.measurement_gap: No utilisation reading for this sample. The worker rows below show their loaded accelerator; this gap does not establish a CPU fallback.
system_health.unreadable_nvidia: {label} is present, but its driver publishes no utilisation counter a container can read.
system_health.unreadable_accelerator: {label} is present, but its counter cannot be read from inside the container.

text_size.label: Text size
text_size.desc: Makes every page larger or smaller on this device only. Large displays still grow a little on top of it.

beta.title: Beta features
beta.subtitle: Features that are still being tested. They are off unless you turn them on, and they may change or be removed.
beta.garden_animals_desc: Automatically identifies non-bird visitors such as cats, dogs and foxes on selected cameras. Confident animals are named; below-threshold checks are dismissed and restorable. When turned off, saved captures are kept.
beta.garden_motion_confidence_invalid: Enter an animal proposal threshold between 50% and 95%.
beta.garden_naming_threshold_invalid: Enter a naming threshold between 70% and 99%.
beta.garden_naming_off: Every animal waits in Needs review for you to confirm and name it.
beta.garden_naming_threshold_help: From 70% to 99%. Higher values automatically name fewer animals and dismiss more low-confidence photos. Person checks are unchanged.
beta.garden_naming_help_floor: Animals reaching this species confidence are confirmed and named automatically. Photos below it move to Dismissed and can be restored. Failed checks retry; missing country or catalogue identity is explained.
beta.garden_requirements: Needs Frigate cameras that track animals or keep motion recordings. Garden downloads its own models when you ask: 224 MB for automatic checks, plus an optional 224 MB species suggestion model and an optional 101 MB motion detector. Your bird model is not changed.
beta.garden_setup_apply: In Connection, choose Garden animals or Both for each camera. Set the animal labels below, then Apply Settings.
beta.garden_setup_models: Download the automatic check model, and the motion detector if a camera collects motion photos.
beta.garden_setup_review: Review new captures in the Explorer.
beta.garden_models_help: Garden uses its own models, separate from your bird model. A download only adds a verified file: it does not save these settings, change bird detection or start any checks.
beta.garden_models_apply: Choose Apply Settings to switch Garden on. Model status and downloads then appear here.
beta.garden_model_check_help: Checks every new capture, dismisses bird-only or empty photos and names confident animals. If it is missing, the first automatic check downloads it.
beta.garden_model_suggestions_help: Used when you choose Suggest species on a confirmed animal. Not needed for automatic checks.
beta.garden_model_motion_help: Finds animals in retained motion footage for cameras with motion photos turned on. Not needed for Frigate animal events.
beta.garden_model_downloading: Downloading and verifying. This can take up to three minutes; you can keep editing settings.
beta.garden_model_download_failed: The download could not be verified. Nothing was changed. Try again.
beta.garden_models_one_at_a_time: One download runs at a time.
beta.garden_models_busy: Garden is busy with a check, scan or download. Refresh the status in a minute.
beta.garden_models_error: Garden work is stopped until the application restarts.
beta.garden_models_status_needed: Downloads are available once the model status loads.
beta.garden_country_missing: Set a country in Settings → Location. Without one, animals are not named automatically and species suggestions are unavailable.
beta.garden_outcome_pending_review: Checks waiting to run, failed checks waiting for retry, missing setup or catalogue identity, and owner overrides.
beta.garden_outcome_confirmed: Animals you confirm, and confident animals named automatically. An automatic name is marked as automatic and can be discarded.
beta.garden_outcome_dismissed_low_score: Captures you dismiss, photos whose species score is below the naming threshold, and photos the check is confident show a bird you do not keep, nothing or a vehicle. Return to review restores one while its photo remains.
beta.garden_outcome_person: A capture with person evidence is removed with its photo. Garden visits never count as birds or reach bird notifications and exports.
beta.garden_models_limits_explorer: Automatic checks follow your Detection device preference after a local CPU comparison, with CPU fallback if the device check fails. Motion scans still use CPU. Garden work runs one at a time while birds and cameras are idle; each worker releases its model memory when it stops. Checks you start from a Garden capture in the Explorer use the device you choose there and fail rather than silently switch devices.
beta.garden_explorer_help: Garden animals appear in the Explorer beside your birds. Choose Garden animals there, then Needs review, to work through new captures.
beta.garden_cameras_none: No camera is watched for Garden animals yet. Choose Garden animals or Both for a camera in Connection.
beta.garden_motion_summary: Motion review photos are collected on {cameras}.
beta.garden_alerts_on: Garden alerts are on. They are set up in Notifications, with their channels.
beta.garden_alerts_off: Garden alerts are off. Turn them on in Notifications, with their channels.
beta.garden_domestic_birds_help: These are recorded as Garden animals, not wild birds, and are never sent to eBird, BirdWeather or iNaturalist.
beta.garden_domestic_birds_wild: Nothing counts as domestic until you add it. Mallards, Greylag Geese, Wild Turkeys and Rock Doves also live wild, so on every camera they are then recorded as your birds.
beta.garden_domestic_birds_none: None yet. Chickens and other birds you keep are treated as wild birds.

native_revalidation.title: Check quarantined profile
native_revalidation.description: Check a saved crash profile with your own bird photos and clip in a disposable worker. This does not classify or alter detection history.
native_revalidation.limits: Choose exactly three different photos, up to 25 MiB each, and one clip up to 32 MiB with at least three readable frames.
native_revalidation.acknowledge: I understand this runs native code and may crash the disposable worker.
native_revalidation.scope: Approval applies only to this exact profile until application restart. Saved crash evidence remains. Inputs are deleted after child cleanup. Leaving this page does not cancel a running check. If cleanup cannot be verified, private inputs remain for owner cleanup after restart.

range_filter.title: Range filter
range_filter.description: Sets aside automatic identifications of birds eBird has never recorded in your region, so a European species is not named at a Californian feeder.
range_filter.toggle: Check new detections against your region
range_filter.toggle_desc: Off by default. Applies to new detections only; nothing already recorded is changed.
range_filter.toggle_disabled_location: Set a location first. The filter needs it to know which region's birds to expect.
range_filter.status_active: Filtering to {count, plural, one {# species} other {# species}} recorded in {region} (eBird, refreshed {age}).
range_filter.status_ready: Off. Turning it on would filter to {count, plural, one {# species} other {# species}} recorded in {region}.
range_filter.status_needs_location_detail: The filter uses the location set under Integrations to find your eBird region.
range_filter.status_needs_key: Add an eBird API key to use range filtering.
range_filter.status_needs_key_detail: eBird's regional list is the only range source. BirdNET-Go can show that a species is here, but never that one is not, so on its own it filters nothing.
range_filter.status_fetching: Fetching the eBird list for your area…
range_filter.status_waiting: Waiting for the first eBird list.
range_filter.status_no_list: No regional list yet. Fetch it to see the effect before turning the filter on.
range_filter.status_lookup_failed: Not filtering: the eBird list could not be fetched. {problem}
range_filter.status_failed_open: Nothing is filtered until a list is fetched. It is tried again every few hours.
range_filter.status_location_changed: Not filtering: your location or region setting changed, so the old list no longer applies.
range_filter.status_stale: Not filtering: the list was fetched {age}. A list older than {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} is not trusted.
range_filter.status_unusable: Not filtering: the stored list failed its checks. {problem}
range_filter.status_error: The range filter status could not be loaded. {message}
range_filter.unsaved_on: Apply settings to turn the filter on.
range_filter.unsaved_off: Apply settings to turn the filter off.

problem.region_not_found: No eBird region was found for your location.
problem.taxonomy_unavailable: eBird's species list could not be read.
problem.response_too_large: eBird sent more data than is allowed.
problem.invalid_response: eBird sent an answer that could not be read.
problem.list_problem: The list was empty or could not be matched to known species.
problem.refresh_failed: The refresh failed for an unexpected reason.

range_filter.age_minutes: {count, plural, one {# minute ago} other {# minutes ago}}
range_filter.age_hours: {count, plural, one {# hour ago} other {# hours ago}}
range_filter.age_days: {count, plural, one {# day ago} other {# days ago}}
range_filter.freshness: Refreshed weekly in the background. A list older than {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} stops filtering until it is refreshed.
range_filter.last_refresh_failed: The last refresh failed. {problem} The current list is still used until it is too old.
range_filter.region_approximate: Your location is approximate, so a state list is used rather than a county.
range_filter.region_country_only: Only a country is set, so the country list is used.
range_filter.region_county_too_short: The county list was too short to trust, so the state list is used.
range_filter.region_neighbours: {count, plural, one {Combined with # neighbouring county, because your feeder is near a border.} other {Combined with # neighbouring counties, because your feeder is near a border.}}
range_filter.heard: {count, plural, one {# species BirdNET-Go heard here in the last year also counts as present.} other {# species BirdNET-Go heard here in the last year also count as present.}}
range_filter.heard_none: Species BirdNET-Go hears here count as present too. It adds evidence and never removes any.
range_filter.unmatched: {count, plural, one {# model label could not be matched to eBird and is never filtered.} other {# model labels could not be matched to eBird and are never filtered.}}
range_filter.seasons: The list covers every season together, so a summer visitor counts as present all year.
range_filter.level_desc: A county list is tighter. An approximate location or a country alone always uses a coarser region.
range_filter.how_title: What happens to a bird outside the range
range_filter.how_fallback: If the model's top answer has never been recorded in your region, its next answer that has been recorded, and still clears your confidence threshold, is used instead. The record keeps a note of what the model said first.
range_filter.how_skip: If no answer qualifies, the detection is not recorded. It is listed below and in the activity log, so a genuine rarity can still be recorded by hand.
range_filter.how_open: Whenever the list is missing, out of date or unreachable, nothing is filtered.
range_filter.how_owner: Species you choose yourself are never filtered.
range_filter.preview_desc: What the filter would set aside with this list and the current model. Detections already recorded stay in your history.
range_filter.preview_error: The preview could not be loaded. {message}
range_filter.preview_unavailable: A preview needs a current list for this location. Refresh the list to see one.
range_filter.preview_seen_heading: {count, plural, one {Recorded here in the last # day} other {Recorded here in the last # days}}
range_filter.preview_seen_none: Nothing recorded here in that time would have been set aside.
range_filter.preview_model_unknown: The current model's labels are not in the species catalogue, so its effect cannot be previewed. Its labels are never filtered.
range_filter.preview_model_total: {count, plural, one {The current model can name # species this list treats as outside the range.} other {The current model can name # species this list treats as outside the range.}}
range_filter.skips_empty: Nothing has been set aside as outside the range.
range_filter.skips_recover: To keep a genuine rarity, record it by hand. Frigate keeps the clip for as long as its retention allows.
